How it connects

Each connector either replicates your data read-only or syncs it on a schedule, and your source systems are never modified. What lands in MemberJunction is one unified layer you own — open source and single-tenant.

Install a connector from the catalog, point it at your account, and it discovers the objects and fields available to you rather than assuming a fixed shape.

What you can do with it

Once your systems are connected, MemberJunction's AI can work across all of it.

  • Agents run multi-step work across every connected system, not just one-off answers.
  • Knowledge Hub searches, classifies and de-duplicates your records and content in one place.
  • DB AutoDoc documents your databases automatically, so even undocumented systems become usable quickly.

What our confidence labels mean

We label every integration by how far it has actually been proven, not by how far it could go. The full engineering detail — what was measured, and what was not — is in the technical overview.

Proven in production
Run against a real production system with real data.
Verified against the live service
Run against the vendor’s real API using a real account.
Verified against a live instance
Run against a real instance of the system, with test data rather than production data.
Verified against the vendor’s API specification
Run against a test double built from the vendor’s published contract.
Standards-built, awaiting live verification
Built and checked against the vendor’s contract; no credential was available to run it live.
Standards-verified build
Built and verified against the vendor’s published API contract and a test double; no credential was available to run it live.

Connectors read your data. Write-back exists for some systems but is not yet verified against a live tenant, so we do not claim it.

Open source · 200+ TypeScript packages on GitHub · Single-tenant · Current as of Q3 2026, updated regularly.
